question: What consequence follows when release from hell is absent?
premises: There is no release from hell.
This is due to its absence.
There is no doubt about this.
inference: The absence of release from hell is certain and unquestionable.
uncertainties: The referent of tasya in tasya+abhāvāt is context-dependent.
plain_english: There is no release from hell; because of its absence, there is no doubt.
